name: Djerba: Testimony to a settlement pattern in an island territory
description: Djerba is North Africa's largest island, lying off Tunisia's southern coast in the Gulf of Gabès. Since about the 9th century, its people have spread out in small, self-sufficient neighbourhoods rather than dense towns, linked by a web of roads to the island's mosques and markets. It's a rare example of a community shaping its life around scarce water.
